component.name: Glate
component.summary: Translate text and generate speech audio on Linux desktop

description.p: Glate is a fast desktop translator with built-in text-to-speech for everyday translation workflows.
It supports translation across 100+ languages, per-line translation view, voice playback, history tracking, and sharing translated text or speech output.
Offline mode translates on your own computer with Mozilla's Firefox translation models: download a language once and translate without internet, and your text never leaves your device.

ul.li: Translate between 100+ languages instantly
Offline translation for nearly 60 languages, with models downloaded on demand (Pro)
Line-by-line translation view for structured content and review
Text-to-speech playback with selectable voice/gender plus audio export tools
Translation history with search, quick load, copy, and remove actions
Share translations via text save, e-mail, and public paste link generation
Standalone About dialog with quick access to project links and developer apps
Global quick-translate hotkey support on X11/XWayland
Available in English, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian
System-following Light/Dark appearance with Fusion and Fusion 2 theme choices

screenshot.caption: Translate between 100+ languages, side by side
Offline mode: translate on your computer, without internet
Download only the offline languages you need
Line-by-line view with copy and read aloud
Share by email or link, save as text, or export speech as audio
Light or dark, two themes and your accent colour

description.p: Theming defaults and custom title bar refinements.

ul.li: Fusion 2 is now the default skin for a cleaner, more modern look out of the box.
The app's own title bar (client-side decorations) now turns on automatically on GNOME/Wayland sessions, where the compositor draws no window controls of its own.
Improved the custom title bar's window border colour for better contrast against the desktop.
More reliable window interaction on the custom title bar, cleanly distinguishing move from edge/corner resize.
Settings now offer an explicit "On close" choice between quitting Glate and minimizing to the system tray.

description.p: Major UI, theming and localization update.

ul.li: Moved About out of Settings into a standalone dialog with direct toolbar access and quick project/developer links.
History list UI reworked for consistent row sizing, spacing and controls across Fusion and Fusion 2 themes.
Default skin switched to Fusion with a lighter default accent colour for better readability.
Fusion combo-box popups now use compact, scrollable height instead of expanding to full screen.
Added localization support for English, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian.
Added in-app language selector and startup locale loading from bundled translations.
Language and custom title bar (CSD) changes now show a restart prompt with “Restart Now” and “Restart Later”.
Updated toolbar/account/about icons and refreshed release metadata.

description.p: Audio export improvements and usability polish.

ul.li: Added read buttons in LineByLine mode
Advanced audio export options
Export dialog remembers the last used folder across sessions
Status messages simplified to remove internal technical terms

description.p: Major update with reworked UX, improved sharing, and single-instance enforcement.

ul.li: Single-instance enforcement: raising the existing window when app is launched again
History window overhauled: item selection, theming, and layout improvements
TTS buttons now disabled when source text is empty
Paste sharing now correctly handles UTF-8 text including CJK and Devanagari scripts
Plan comparison dialog shows Free, Evaluation, and Pro feature differences
Dark and light theme contrast improvements across dialogs
Snap packaging updated to core24 with CMake-based builds
Added Flatpak manifest and CI release artifacts
Aligned desktop metadata with reverse-DNS app ID for stores
